- [RemoteOrchestrationTest.java](/E:/Projects/Code/AI/Ji/ji-java/products/ji-remote-bootstrap/src/test/java/io/github/diodeme/ji/remote/RemoteOrchestrationTest.java:484) merged the `FakeRunner` ssh-keyscan branch into one that keeps B1's `holdScan` blocking hooks and the host-key exit-code/stderr fields; 13 original tests grew to 15, all green.

No new state, second state machine, or fallback branch was introduced.

**Verification, all freshly run on the merged tree (`2355382`)**

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| `./gradlew check --offline --rerun-tasks --no-build-cache` ×2 | BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 163/163 tasks executed each (2m58s / 2m50s) |
| `pnpm --filter @ji/web-app test` | 31 files / 217 tests |
| `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` / production build | exit 0 / `✓ built in 4.05s` |
| `pnpm check:generated` / `buf lint protocol/relay` | 122 files reproducible / exit 0 |

| Real Host install → authorized Ubuntu target | 8/8 PASS, `succeeded`, gate fingerprint `ssh-ed25519 SHA256:xdlm0…`, `restPort=36183` |
| Provider round-trip (`dialogue-roundtrip.mjs`) | `RESULT=ALL_PASS`, assistant replied `ACK` |
| Merged scan probe vs real target | `keys=3`; Windows OpenSSH candidate exits 1 with `unsupported KEX`, Git's succeeds — the fallback really is what produced the keys |

The four BLOCKERs therefore hold simultaneously: B1 terminal guard (plus `OrchestrationEndpointTest` 3/3 repeats — that case was the load-sensitive flake pre-merge), B2 scan resilience, B3 confirmation decoupling, B4 projection round-trip.
